name: Tomb Weed
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
If you're heading east, towards the Balnir Farmstead, I have more you might do for me. Good help is ever so hard to find these days, as your run-in with Gordo illuminates ever so clearly.

As I acquire doom weed I perform some minor alchemical alterations and replant them on that farmstead to cultivate my ultimate creation. I call it tomb weed, and it shall be the herald of my glorious destiny.

Do keep an eye on the Scourge in the area while you're there. They seem... drawn... to the weed. Curious.
narrative.objectives: Collect 5 Tomb Weed and deliver them back to Junior Apothecary Holland.
narrative.offerRewardText: Most glorious indeed!<Junior Apothecary Holland inspects the weeds.>Hmm, I had hoped they would have matured a bit more violently. Nevertheless, progress is progress!A great many will die as a result of your actions this day. You should be proud.
narrative.requestItemsText: More interruptions! Wait, it's you. Were you able to recover the tomb weed?
